blocks.text: 🪝 Uttar Pradesh Launches Digi Rover (GNSS) Centimetre-Accurate Land Measurement Campaign. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Deploys Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) rovers across all UP tehsils to resolve land disputes.
Campaign Duration: Digi Rover-GNSS Special Land Measurement Campaign runs July 1 to August 15, 2026.
Technology: Uses GNSS satellite instruments for centimetre-level accurate land demarcation under DILRMP.
